sprites.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated game object sprite, genuine TRANSPARENT background, clean alpha. Two inputs: IMAGE 1 is the mandatory mathematical CAMERA/PROJECTION guide only; IMAGE 2 is the mandatory Japanese anime fantasy ART-STYLE reference only. Reconstruct this object in exactly the orthographic dimetric camera of image 1, not a cinematic perspective. Camera yaw 45 degrees, elevation 30 degrees, 2:1 ground projection. Both horizontal ground axes have screen vectors (2,1) and (-2,1), all parallel physical edges stay parallel; every vertical is screen-vertical. No perspective convergence or foreshortening by distance. Floor bases are a diamond whose full width is exactly twice its height. Window sill and wall-base lines follow +/-26.565 degrees, same left/right axis scale. Ridge is parallel to one ground axis; roof slope lines can be steeper according to pitch. No camera variations. Art: beautifully detailed clean Japanese anime fantasy RPG illustration, warm amber lights from upper-left, cool soft shadows, blue-violet roof tiles, cream masonry, warm timber, gold touches and flowers, matching image2. Entire object visible centered in a square canvas, roughly 85 percent fill with transparent margins. Only a thin closely attached foundation as necessary, no surrounding terrain or broad platform, no background, no black/white/checkerboard painted backdrop, no people, animals, letters, labels, UI or watermark. The object will be independently placed on a 2:1 game map. Subject: compact two-storey POTION AND MAGICAL-ITEM SHOP. A clear rectangular footprint on the shared grid, one blue-violet gabled roof, cream plaster walls with wood framing, deep purple front awning, open storefront with rows of jewel-colored potion bottles and crystals, a hanging potion-bottle pictogram without writing, a few small attached crates and modest flower boxes. Front facade faces lower-left, other wall faces lower-right. Do not tilt or rotate the building away from the camera guide.
